Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.name: Deal Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Deal Agent is surfaced through Sales Agent. It is not a standalone agent to install or select; it triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Discover agreements and EA/EAS enrollments, generate and reuse renewal Deal Books, explore growth scenarios, and support EA quotes, proposals, amendments and pre-approvals through Sales Agent. Provides integrated MCA-E policy/process/licensing guidance and tools for MCA-E proposal creation or revision, including BYOD and MACC configuration where applicable. Validate returned deal data and recommendations; tool capability does not grant commercial, legal, funding or customer approval.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: For an enterprise EA/EAS renewal, start with an account name, TPID, PCN or Master Agreement when the enrollment is unknown; review returned enrollment details before selecting the intended enrollment. Known agreement/enrollment identifiers remain valid for their specific tasks. For applicable MCA-E work, ask sourced policy/process/licensing questions or use proposal creation and revision tools within your authority. Inspect recorded MACC and growth scenarios where they help the renewal decision; treat recommendations as hypotheses.
keyBenefits: Brings deal facts, renewal context, Deal Books, and proposal work into the Sales Agent conversation instead of gathering them across separate portals. Keeps the capability visible while retaining one entry point and human review of commercial decisions.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile

Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Agent J.ai
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Text-based coaching experience grounded in Microsoft 365 context and curated content.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Helps users sharpen messages, rehearse conversations, anticipate objections, and plan next steps.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Customer conversation preparation and role-play, or de-identified rehearsal of a manager coaching conversation about business judgment where access and scenario support are confirmed. Do not use employee or HR data for rehearsal.
keyBenefits: Rehearsal before the real conversation. Sharpens messages, surfaces objections you had not anticipated, and coaches on clarity and next step, grounded in Microsoft 365 context and curated content.

resources.title: Open Agent J.ai

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use as the authoritative source for CRM or commercial data.

primaryAgents.name: Cowork
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.
keyBenefits: Executes multi-step work across Microsoft 365 instead of answering one question at a time. Built for delegation: it plans, invokes skills, works across data sources, and produces deliverables with review checkpoints.

resources.title: Copilot Cowork overview
resources.description: Overview of Cowork tasks, skills and action controls. Optional tool guidance, not a Dynamics 365 Sales skills guide.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: What to Use When
resources.description: Routes a request to the best-fit Copilot agent and reserves Cowork for longer multi-output work. Useful early in a role path when tool choice is still forming.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Avoid for a quick single answer when Copilot or a specialized agent is sufficient, and for work that should keep running on a schedule after you stop asking, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot and select Cowork beside Chat. Describe the outcome you want rather than a single question, then review the work at each checkpoint it presents.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Cowork
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.
keyBenefits: Executes multi-step work across Microsoft 365 instead of answering one question at a time. Built for delegation: it plans, invokes skills, works across data sources, and produces deliverables with review checkpoints.

resources.title: Copilot Cowork overview
resources.description: Overview of Cowork tasks, skills and action controls. Optional tool guidance, not a Dynamics 365 Sales skills guide.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: What to Use When
resources.description: Routes a request to the best-fit Copilot agent and reserves Cowork for longer multi-output work. Useful early in a role path when tool choice is still forming.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Avoid for a quick single answer when Copilot or a specialized agent is sufficient, and for work that should keep running on a schedule after you stop asking, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot and select Cowork beside Chat. Describe the outcome you want rather than a single question, then review the work at each checkpoint it presents.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official Sales agent overview and example prompts for connected CRM data. Internal sales scenarios and available records can differ.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Cowork
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.
keyBenefits: Executes multi-step work across Microsoft 365 instead of answering one question at a time. Built for delegation: it plans, invokes skills, works across data sources, and produces deliverables with review checkpoints.

resources.title: Copilot Cowork overview
resources.description: Overview of Cowork tasks, skills and action controls. Optional tool guidance, not a Dynamics 365 Sales skills guide.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: What to Use When
resources.description: Routes a request to the best-fit Copilot agent and reserves Cowork for longer multi-output work. Useful early in a role path when tool choice is still forming.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Avoid for a quick single answer when Copilot or a specialized agent is sufficient, and for work that should keep running on a schedule after you stop asking, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot and select Cowork beside Chat. Describe the outcome you want rather than a single question, then review the work at each checkpoint it presents.

primaryAgents.name: ECIF Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Through Sales Agent, ECIF Agent brings program guidance, guided workscope drafts, guided creation/submission of supported investment requests, request-draft editing and delivery-health signals together with account and opportunity context. The full end-to-end conversational investment lifecycle is still evolving.
primaryAgents.whatItIs: Investment guidance and supported workflows surfaced through Sales Agent.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Discover programs and prior investments/yield; search suppliers; create guided AI workscope drafts; create and submit supported investment requests, edit request drafts, link workscopes and select consumption plans; review milestones, delivery health and risk. Compliance hold/release is role-permitted; eligibility, supplier selection and approval remain governed decisions.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Discovering programs or suppliers for an evidenced investment need; preparing guided workscope drafts; creating/submitting supported investment requests or editing request drafts; reviewing available milestones and delivery risk. Confirm request-type coverage and role permissions; this does not imply saved-workscope editing or full Agent MCR.
keyBenefits: Simplifies investment preparation and progression by bringing program guidance, supplier search, guided workscope drafts and supported guided request creation, draft editing and submission into one conversation; helps teams review milestone and delivery-risk evidence. Generated drafts and signals still need human verification.

resources.description: ECIF support entry point in MCAPS Help. This link does not confer approval or funding authority.

resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Open ECIF Central
resources.description: Open ECIF Central for workscope and delivery detail. Use Sales Agent for investment guidance and supported request-draft work. Confirm the program-specific submission and approval path with current guidance; Azure Accelerate, Azure Access and CSP need not follow the same route. Use MCAPS Help for access or process blockers.

resources.title: ECIF Agent: current capabilities and limits
resources.description: Current ECIF Agent guidance in Sales Agent: program and supplier discovery, guided workscope drafts, supported request-draft work, delivery-health signals and in-progress features. Use it to distinguish draft types and check capability boundaries; program-specific process guidance still governs.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat the agent as the final authority for policy, eligibility, compliance, funding approval, or supplier selection. Review generated content and required evidence before submission, and use governed ECIF channels for exceptions or approvals.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Sales Agent and ask for ECIF, process or program help in the chat. The current capability guide can help distinguish supported steps from in-progress features. Use reviewed text and analysis in the huddle; any request or record change needs a separate authorized action.

secondaryAgents.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
secondaryAgents.shortDescription: AI assistant across Microsoft 365 apps and work data.
secondaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Draft, summarize, analyze, prepare, and create within familiar Microsoft 365 experiences.
secondaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Everyday work grounded in emails, meetings, chats, files and app content, in the app you are already working in. Ask and get: you want the answer or the draft now.
keyBenefits: Reduces time spent drafting, summarizing, and preparing work; uses permitted Microsoft 365 context to keep work grounded.

resources.title: Workforce Transformation Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

secondaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use as a substitute for a specialized agent when the work requires a specific system or workflow, for a multi-step task you would rather hand off and review, which is Cowork, or for work that should keep running on a schedule, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot from the app launcher or copilot.cloud.microsoft and start in Chat.

activities.name: Prioritize account action for this week
activities.description: Use Sales Agent and available sales context to rank accounts and name one next action for each.
activities.prompt: Across [assigned account list or authorized territory scope], propose up to ten accounts deserving attention this week, fewer if evidence is insufficient. Show each priority driver, active opportunity stage, renewal or whitespace signal, partner context and one seller action, with dated evidence and gaps. Distinguish account actuals from portfolio rollups and missing access. Whitespace is a hypothesis, not customer-confirmed demand. Additional context: [add a short note or relevant source link]; if this placeholder is unchanged, ignore this field and continue.
activities.expectedOutput: A proposed weekly account ranking with dated priority evidence, available stage/renewal/whitespace/partner context, missing inputs and one seller action per account.
activities.humanCheckpoint: The AE decides which account genuinely deserves attention this week. A ranking built from recorded signal cannot see a relationship about to open or close, and cannot know what is realistic in the days actually available.
activities.requiredContext: Your account list; access to opportunity, renewal and whitespace signals; partner coverage for those accounts.
activities.whyThisMatters: Prioritization is a decision about what will not get attention.

agents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

activities.name: Build or assess the account plan with approval gates
activities.description: Assess the account plan and suggest additions supported by the customer evidence.
activities.prompt: For [Customer/Account], review [account plan and supporting evidence]. Suggest updates to priorities, stakeholders, opportunities and next steps, linking each to its source. Distinguish customer-confirmed needs from internal signals or hypotheses and identify the next customer check. Propose changes only; don’t update MSX, contact anyone or make commitments. Flag missing sources rather than assuming access.
activities.expectedOutput: An account-plan assessment with proposed updates and evidence gaps.
activities.humanCheckpoint: Decide which proposed changes fit the customer and should be taken forward.
activities.requiredContext: Customer/account; current account plan and approved supporting evidence.
activitySteps: 1. Supply the customer/account, current plan and supporting evidence.
2. Run the assessment and inspect one proposed change against its source.
3. Discuss which change you would accept, reject or investigate.
activities.whyThisMatters: Account planning becomes usable when it creates next actions, not just more content.

activities.name: Pressure-test the account priority list
activities.description: Challenge whether your account priorities are driven by evidence or by habit and familiarity.
activities.prompt: Review the supplied priority list for [account list or territory scope]. For each of the top accounts, state the evidence behind the priority and whether it reflects a current signal or a standing assumption. Identify the account most likely to be wrongly prioritized, the account most likely to be wrongly ignored, and what would confirm either.
activities.expectedOutput: A priority challenge showing evidence per account, plus the most likely over-prioritized and under-prioritized account.
activities.humanCheckpoint: The AE decides which account is genuinely mis-prioritized. A model sees only the signals that were recorded, and the account most often wrongly ignored is the one whose activity happens off-system.
activities.requiredContext: The prioritized account list; the source signal behind each priority; the accounts you have not touched recently.
activities.whyThisMatters: Challenge familiar account priorities before they consume a week that a better-supported account needed.
